name: Add Port Monitor Persistence in Registry
description:
Adversaries may use port monitors to run an attacker supplied DLL during system boot for persistence or privilege escalation.
A port monitor can be set through the AddMonitor API call to set a DLL to be loaded at startup.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (registry.path:*\\Control\\Print\\Monitors\\* AND winlog.event_data.Details:*.dll) AND (NOT ((process.executable:C\:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv.exe AND registry.path:*\\Control\\Print\\Monitors\\CutePDF\ Writer\ Monitor\ v4.0\\Driver* AND winlog.event_data.Details:cpwmon64_v40.dll AND (user.name:(*AUTHORI* OR *AUTORI*))) OR registry.path:*\\Control\\Print\\Monitors\\MONVNC\\Driver* OR (registry.path:*Control\\Print\\Environments\\* AND registry.path:*\\Drivers\\* AND registry.path:*\\VNC\ Printer*)))
